title: Titanium Flashlight Body

This rationale is driven by premium edc flashlight body tube and service environment demands.

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Flashlight Body suitable for Premium EDC flashlight body tube?
faq.a: Titanium Flashlight Body uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address edc operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Flashlight Body?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Flashlight Body is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for premium edc flashlight requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Flashlight Body require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. premium edc flashlight components require PVD TiAlN coating (2-3um, HV2500 hardness) for scratch resistance and uniform gunmetal aesthetic finish — tailored for premium edc flashlight application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Flashlight Body shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Flashlight Body includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet premium edc flashlight specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
